title: Puzzle 2D React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for puzzle 2D in the React renderer: fix camera transform sign bug, sync BoardHost pointer hit-testing with rendered frame, and add shape/color/selection fidelity to Canvas2d layers.
summary:
Restored Puzzle 2D premigration performance and visual fidelity by mounting the real WASM/WebGPU BoardSession directly in React instead of the slow JSON-layers Canvas2D reimplementation.

- Added SurfaceKind::Puzzle2dBoard + Puzzle2dBoardScene + build_puzzle2d_board_scene in framework core
- New Puzzle2dBoardHost React component: attach_canvas, RAF renderFrame, theme sync, interactive pointer/wheel, drainEventsJson → applyBoardEvents
- Puzzle 2D plugin now emits puzzle2d-board scenes; removed canvas_layers_json and per-frame canvasPointer* round-trips
- Wired @semio-tech/puzzle-2d-rs workspace package and dev wasm build for puzzle/puzzle2d plugins

Validation: puzzle_2d wasm rebuilt; cargo check core+wgpu ok; vitest 23 passed. cargo test -p puzzle-plugin still blocked by pre-existing component_export_anchor macro error.
